clear.done: Context cleared. The history remains readable.

think.clamped: {model} does not support this level, using {level} instead.

vision.auto: Vision companion model now follows the admin default.
vision.off: Vision companion model disabled for this conversation.

compact.automatic: Context is automatically summarized once it reaches the limit. Use /clear to clear it immediately.

context.enabledNoPage: As soon as you open a page, the AI sees its title and path and can load the content itself if needed.
context.enabled: The AI sees the title and path and can load the content itself if needed.
context.disabled: Page context is off: the AI sees nothing of it.
context.howOff: Use /context off to turn it off.
context.howOn: Use /context on to turn it on.

rules.none: No active AI rule pages in this workspace.

tools.policyDeny: Modifying tools are disabled in this workspace.
tools.policyGuarded: Modifying tools are locked once a run reads external content (uploaded documents, image descriptions).
tools.policyAllow: Modifying tools remain allowed even after reading external content.
tools.subset: An individual run is not offered all of them, only the areas that fit the question. If one is missing, the AI enables it itself using exo_toolbox.

descriptions.context: Show or toggle page context and pinned sources
